name: Avalora Moon-Grove Stagwarden
loreTies: A living border guardian grown from Avalora memory groves, hostile when foreign forces wound terrain or steal moon-root relics.
Controls paths with roots and punishes straight-line movement.
source culture humans later copied as Celtic and Irish fae myth
shortBackstory: Avalora Moon-Grove Stagwarden is a lore-faithful Tuatha run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Avalora Moon-Grove Stagwarden belongs to Avalora and exists to express Tuatha law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Controls paths with roots and punishes straight-line movement.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Silver antlered guardian, bark-and-moss armor, moonlit leaf mantle, root bow. Abilities — Moonroot Shot, Grove Snare, Memory Antler — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
